ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=49a7631b1ddb ('Profiling with firepit') refactored checkout-service startup sequencing in main.go and profiling.go. As a side effect, the call to evaluateFlag() in handler.go:112 now executes before the featureFlagClient is assigned in the initialization routine (flags.go:47). The nil-guard that previously prevented early access was removed during the refactor, causing every inbound /checkout request to panic with NullPointerException: featureFlagClient is nil from the moment the service started accepting traffic.
ground_truth_remediation: Roll back checkout-service to the prior stable deploy sha=bb0e91424e8a. This restores the initialization ordering where featureFlagClient is guaranteed non-nil before any request handler can invoke evaluateFlag(). After rollback, verify error rate returns below 1% and feature-flag-service logs show resumed evaluation requests. Before re-deploying 49a7631b1ddb, add an explicit nil-guard in flags.go evaluateFlag() and a startup integration test asserting client initialization completes before the HTTP server begins accepting requests.
